node: AI accelerators, HBM, advanced-node foundry and advanced packaging
summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Expanded the US-listed universe for the AI accelerator/HBM/advanced-packaging capacity node. The strongest incremental candidates are direct HBM suppliers, advanced-packaging OSAT capacity owners, semiconductor equipment/process-control leaders, and custom AI accelerator platforms tied to HBM and multi-die packaging. This is research support only, not a buy/sell list. Expanded the US-listed universe around the AI accelerator/HBM/advanced-packaging chokepoint. The most relevant public-market mappings for this pass are: leading advanced-node foundry and CoWoS/SoIC capacity, HBM memory supply, outsourced advanced packaging/test, process equipment enabling DRAM/HBM and advanced packaging, and inspection/metrology tools required for yield learning. This is research support only, not a buy/sell recommendation. Expanded US-listed universe for the AI accelerator/HBM/advanced-packaging capacity node. This pass prioritizes second-order bottlenecks around HBM supply, outsourced advanced packaging/test capacity, inspection/metrology, and probe-card/test interfaces rather than branded accelerator designers. Candidates are research leads only, not recommendations.
